| Deci"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"de | Reports `create | append | blocked` separately from note shape. |
| Review | Returns duplicate "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"risk, backlink suggestions, and an exact patch plan. |
| Approve | Asks `Apply this reviewed change?"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"`; the selected plan ID stays internal. |

| Links are guessed while writing | "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"Backlinks come from actual vault notes |
